items.title: Chick Corea — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: And with Mongo Santamaria...the dancers that I used to play for up in Harlem with Mongo’s band, with the dancers sweating out there, and us having a ball.

ctx.x: ...in your own bands and in other situations. Speaking of that, not long after you got to New York (I’m not sure how long it was), you were playing with Mongo Santamaria.

It was my first major gig with Mongo. It must have been 1960, late ‘60, something like that. Yeah, I got the gig with Mongo. Somehow, my friend, Al Abreu, who was the tenor player in the band at the time, he knew that I liked Latin music, and I spent a year-and-a-half playing with Mongo.
So really right after you got to New York.
